\documentclass{article}
% \pop drops the top of a token-list stack; \fill puts unknown text on top.
\def\popp#1#2\stop#3{\def#3{#1}\toks2={#2}}
\def\pop#1{\ifx\u\relax\fi\expandafter\popp\the\toks2 \stop#1}
\def\x{\pop\a}
\def\fill{\edef\u{\romannumeral\pdfelapsedtime }\toks2=\expandafter{\expandafter{\u}{}}}
\begin{document}
\fill\x \fill\x \fill\x
\edef\u{\romannumeral\pdfelapsedtime }\toks2=\expandafter{\expandafter{\u}{K}{}}\x\x
\def\want{K}\ifx\a\want\gdef\ok{}\fi
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
